name: Backseat Rally
creator: No crash plez
redeem: Launch Backseat Rally on Roblox and wait for the main menu.
Click Settings at the bottom of the menu (Camera, audio, controls).
Open the Game tab at the top ("Graphics, other cars and codes").
Type the code into the Redeem a code box and press Redeem. Each code works once per account.
notes:
Backseat Rally is a co-op rally racing game on Roblox from No crash plez, released in early October 2026. One player drives while a friend in the passenger seat reads the road and calls out the turns, so the driver goes almost entirely on their co-driver's calls. Playing solo, a friend's avatar rides along as an AI co-driver instead.

There are 7 cars and 5 stages through pine forests, snowy passes and cherry-blossom roads, with rain, mud and snow changing how the car handles. You can chase medals on each stage or race other players head-to-head. Codes give Credits (CR), which you spend in the Shop on livery crates, new cars and customisation in My Garage.

faq.q: Where do you redeem Backseat Rally codes?
faq.a: Not in the Shop: open Settings from the main menu, go to the Game tab, and the Redeem a code box is the third row, under Graphics and Other cars.

faq.q: What are Credits (CR) for in Backseat Rally?
faq.a: Credits buy livery crates and new cars in the Shop, and paint, wheels and other parts for your car in My Garage.

faq.q: Where does Backseat Rally post new codes?
faq.a: The settings screen says codes come with updates and on the game's socials. RELEASE was the launch code; new ones usually arrive with updates.
